content.value: The transactions of M/S Rupsha & Co. are as follows:
April 01: Opening balance of cash Tk. 27,000 and balance of bank Tk. 19,500.
02: . Goods purchase for cash Tk. 8,000 and goods sales for cash Tk. 12,000.
05: Received a cheque Tk. 6,000 from M/S Arif & Sons and deposited the same immediately in to the bank.
09: Drawing cash from bank Tk. 7,500 for office.
13: Materials purchase from Kajol Enterprise amount of Tk. 8,500 on credit.
20: Deposited cash Tk. 4,600 in to the bank.
24: Paid to Kajol Enterprise by cheque Tk. 8,500.
27: Rent expense paid in cash Tk. 4,500.
28: Bank interest credited Tk. 200 and bank charge debited Tk. 100.
Required: Double column cash book in the books of M/S Rupsha & Co.
